name: GHRP-6

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A synthetic hexapeptide growth hormone secretagogue, the earliest of the GHRP series, with pronounced appetite stimulation. It has no FDA-approved product and no approved labelling. No FDA label exists.

systems.note: Ghrelin receptor agonism at the somatotroph; placed on the pituitary by intended effect.
Sought for anabolic effect; strong appetite stimulation is characteristic.
Raised GH exposure antagonises insulin action.

monitors.why: The practical index of achieved GH exposure.
Non-selective secretagogue with described cortisol rise.
